muxt test-template-mutations

--help:
Vary each dynamic and control flow action in the project's templates, one
at a time, and re-run the tests against each variation.

A variation the tests still pass through is a miss: nothing the suite
asserts on depends on what that action does. A variation that makes a
test fail is caught, which is the outcome to want.

The tests run once unmutated first. If that baseline fails, nothing is
mutated, because every later failure would be indistinguishable from the
one already there.

Variations are delivered through the go command's -overlay flag, so the
working tree is never written to.

Full reference: muxt documentation docs/reference/commands/test-template-mutations.md

Usage:
  muxt test-template-mutations [package-dir] [-- go test flags] [flags]

Aliases:
  test-template-mutations, mut, m

Flags:
      --diff string                      only mutate templates whose text, or the type of dot they are rendered with, changed since this git revision
      --dry-run                          enumerate the mutants and report them without running any tests
      --format string                    output format (text or json) (default "text")
  -h, --help                             help for test-template-mutations
      --include-test-callers             also mutate templates reached only from ExecuteTemplate calls in _test.go files
      --include-uncovered-nodes          run mutants in template nodes no test reaches instead of skipping them
      --max-cases int                    most operand combinations one action may contribute (default 8)
      --run string                       only run tests matching this regular expression (passed to go test -run)
      --seed uint                        seed the values substituted for an action's operands (default: drawn and reported)
      --template-pattern string          only mutate templates whose name matches this regular expression
      --use-templates-variable strings   the name of the global variable with type *"html/template".Template in the working directory package. (default [templates])
  -v, --verbose                          report every mutant, not only the ones no test caught, and stream progress
      --workers int                      how many mutants to run at once; the tests must tolerate running beside themselves; a kill is repeated alone, and one that does not repeat is reported flaky (default 1)

Global Flags:
  -C, --change-directory string   change the working directory
